ArrayRankIndicator.Definition: Indicates an additional dimension within a multidimensional array type declaration.

NullableTypeMarker.Definition: A suffix on a type name that indicates the type is nullable — it can hold its normal range of values or {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c}.

NullConditionalGuard.Definition: The null-guard component of a null-conditional access expression. It short-circuits the access and returns {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c} if the preceding value is {c:color-blue keyword}null{/c}.

PointerTypeIndicator.Definition: Indicates that this is a pointer type — a type that holds a memory address pointing to a value rather than the value itself.

AnonymousObjectMemberDeclarationSeparato.Definition: Separates member declarations within an anonymous object creation expression.

ArgumentSeparator.Definition: Separates arguments in a method, constructor, or function call.

ArrayInitializerElementSeparator.Definition: Separates elements within an array initializer.

ArrayLengthSeparator.Definition: Separates the size values of each dimension in a multidimensional array creation expression.

AttributeArgumentSeparator.Definition: Separates arguments within an attribute argument list.

BaseTypeSeparator.Definition: Separates entries in a base type list, such as between a base class and implemented interfaces.

CollectionElementSeparator.Definition: Separates elements within a collection expression or initializer.

ComplexElementSeparator.Definition: Separates the key from the value within a key-value element, such as in a {c:color-green code}Dictionary{/c} initializer.

DeconstructionVariableSeparator.Definition: Separates variables within a deconstruction expression.

EnumMemberSeparator.Definition: Separates member declarations within an enum.

InterpolationFormatSeparator.Definition: Separates the interpolated expression from its format specifier within an interpolation block.

MemberPatternSeparator.Definition: Separates the member name from the pattern to match against it within a property pattern.

OrderByClauseSeparator.Definition: Separates elements within an {c:color-blue keyword}orderby{/c} clause.

ParameterSeparator.Definition: Separates parameters in a method, constructor, or lambda declaration.

PatternElementSeparator.Definition: Separates elements within a pattern matching expression.

PropertyInitializationSeparator.Definition: Separates a property name from its assigned value in a property initialization context.

QualifiedNameSeparator.Definition: Separates components of a fully qualified namespace or type name.

SwitchArmSeparator.Definition: Separates consecutive arms within a switch expression.

TypeArgumentSeparator.Definition: Separates type arguments supplied to a generic type or method.

TypeParameterConstraintClauseSeparator.Definition: Separates a generic type parameter from its constraint list in a {c:color-blue keyword}where{/c} clause.

VariableDeclaratorSeparator.Definition: Separates multiple variable declarations within a single statement.

CaseLabelTerminator.Definition: Terminates a case label in a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} statement.

CasePatternLabelTerminator.Definition: Terminates a case pattern label in a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} statement.

DefaultLabelTerminator.Definition: Terminates the {c:color-purple keyword}default{/c} label in a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} statement.

ParameterLabelTerminator.Definition: Terminates a parameter name label in a named argument.

StatementTerminator.Definition: Marks the end of a statement.
